name: Pennylane
description: Pennylane lets agents read accounting data such as invoices, transactions, and ledger entries. Access is read-only.

prompts.text: List customer invoices that are overdue.
Summarize supplier expenses by category for last quarter.
How did revenue this month compare with the same month last year?

apps.name: Pennylane
apps.description: Invoice, transaction, and ledger reading, over Pennylane's MCP server with browser sign-in.
